messages:
hana: Quick UX sync: the Min/Max inputs and SLO slider are getting mixed feedback. Users said the label semantics aren't clear (what does Max protect vs allow?). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABCD (frame 'capacity/minmax-slo'). mira: Good point. Proposal: change 'Max GPUs' helper to 'Autoscaler upper bound (normal traffic)'. And add a separate small tag 'Burst cap' displayed when Burst is on. alex: Dev note: adding a 'Burst cap' chip is easy. We should avoid showing two overlapping caps in same row. Could render: Max: 8 • Burst cap: 12 (when burst enabled). sara: Accessibility: ensure chips are semantic text (not just decorative). Screen readers should read "Burst cap 12 GPUs". Also steppers need name/role exposed: aria-label='Min GPUs' / 'Max GPUs'. hana: Also users wanted a micro-example beneath the labels: "If traffic spikes above Max, autoscaler tries to scale up to Burst cap for short periods." Short and inline. mira: Let's standardize copy: Labels: 'Min GPUs', 'Max GPUs'. Helper under Max: 'Autoscaler upper bound (normal traffic)'. Burst tooltip: 'Short spikes may exceed Max up to Burst cap; extra GPUs billed at premium.' alex: I'll add aria-live announcements for changes: "Max GPUs set to 8; Burst enabled". For markup, something like:

```
Max GPUs: 8
``` I'll ensure it's polite not assertive. sara: Also color nits: the burst chip background doesn't currently meet contrast. Use a darker amber and ensure text is 14px semibold. mira: I'll update Figma with the chip, helper copy, and the micro-example. We'll test with keyboard-only flow and one screen reader pass. hana: Thanks team. Small action list: 1) Update copy in Figma, 2) add burst chip pattern, 3) dev prototype with aria-live and proper labels, 4) a11y pass. Back in 24h for PR review. :thumbsup:
